# Exit codes

Both binaries exit with one of these statuses
([04 4.1](../spec/04-cli.md#41-conventions-both-binaries)); each error
of [errors.md](errors.md) names its own.

| Exit | Meaning | Ids |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | ok |  |
| 1 | the operation failed | `RJ-348` |
| 2 | usage or precondition | `RJ-349` |
| 3 | approval required |  |
| 4 | drift detected, or an interrupted promotion abandoned |  |
| 5 | refused to protect data |  |
| 6 | the check ran and found what it checks for |  |
| 130 | ended by SIGINT |  |
| 143 | ended by SIGTERM |  |

A signal wins over a failure the command had already found (1 to 6); a command that had finished its work keeps 0.
